value.hook: Before reviewing real-tmux warm-ups, teardown flakes or cancellation-sweep repairs
value.title: Flaky test repairs must preserve the concurrency oracle

sections.name: body
sections.value:
#278/F228: serialize control-client startup, not reservations. Keep separate adapters/locks and both acquire_submit calls after Barrier(3). Warm-up only works around tmux 3.6a's concurrent attach/setup crash; the production fix remains F229.

Check teardown in both directions: nonzero kill-server after actual death must pass; nonzero kill-server leaving the server alive must fail. Independent shim controls proved both branches; remove the shim and verify fixture cleanup.

For cancellation sweeps, wait for committed state rather than treating poll count as a clock. Join owned admissions with flush(), and retain the assertion that at least one caller was dropped with admission in flight. Both repaired tests passed 20/20 independently; verdict at 7380b7c.
